backend.active_computation_backend: Backend reported by the runtime architecture graph engine.
backend.parity_verified_queries: Runtime backend counter for queries verified against the reference traversal.

claim_linkage.claims_citing_graph_tool_evidence_count: Diagnosis claim items whose evidence_refs include a successful ledger evidence ID from any registered graph-derived tool family.

graph_query_usage.attempt_count: Number of graph_neighbors/graph_path ledger entries, including failed calls.
graph_query_usage.complete_query_count: Successful results with coverage_status=complete_for_query and truncated=false.
graph_query_usage.failed_call_count: Graph query attempts without an accepted structured result.
graph_query_usage.mode_counts: Counts by graph_neighbors direction or graph_path.
graph_query_usage.partial_or_truncated_query_count: Successful graph queries that are not complete.
graph_query_usage.successful_call_count: Entries with status ok and a structured result object.

provider_resource_usage.estimated_cost_usd_reserved: Investigator's explicitly reserved cost estimate, when configured.

source_follow_through.eligible_newly_surfaced_path_count: Unique source paths surfaced by complete results from any of the five registered graph-derived tools that had not already been read before first surfacing. For find_related_tests, only static_import relationship candidates count; text_reference candidates are excluded.
source_follow_through.verified_complete_hash_matching_path_cou: Eligible paths read after surfacing with a complete requested line range and matching graph-snapshot SHA-256.
source_follow_through.verified_follow_through_rate: Verified path count divided by eligible newly surfaced path count; null when denominator is zero.

non_claims: No semantic entailment or causal correctness inference.
No graph benefit or counterfactual superiority inference from one run.
No human review or adjudication requirement.
